## How was it tested?

CI runs `npm run validate:json`, `npm run lint` and the unit tests automatically. None of
them covers Foundry itself, so please also say what you clicked through in a real world.
-->

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally (manifest validation, lint, unit tests)
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes locally
- [ ] Verified in Foundry VTT

## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`) — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] No AI tool attribution in commit messages (`Co-Authored-By: Claude ...` and similar)
- [ ] No art, icons or text taken from another module
- [ ] Updated the README and the screenshots (`npm run docs:screenshots`) if the change is user-visible
- [ ] No unrelated changes bundled in
